# Bounded native network regression

Unfrozen product fixture. Reuses existing CLI control-stream/native.py byte-for-byte SHA f54cf87382ad3688f026e10932983b873800ee2847e14ac5da859e7bca0dccb3 through exact-once insertion anchors, without editing it. Existing real provider/sidecar/control stream/abort/process-identity cleanup assertions all remain. No Cargo, frozen apparatus or shared product edits.

probe.py accepts the existing --control/--gateway/--sidecar/--host-mode gateway|control-serve/--signal TERM|INT/--out plus --baseline, --source-receipt and --provenance-label. Source receipt schema is the root candidate manifest with binaries keyed pilotdeck-control/pilotdeck-gateway/pilotdeck-agent-loop-sidecar. Each binary is checked against that receipt, copied to exclusive execution snapshot, and rechecked before/after. Output must not exist. It holds the existing parity lock (1s bounded refusal), retaining cleanupPending if identity cleanup cannot be verified.

Example on mbp2, with absolute files from one source-bound candidate:

python3 -I src/pilotdeck-gateway/tests/fixtures/native-network/probe.py --baseline /Users/da/ws/pdrs-runner/resources/PilotDeck --source-receipt /absolute/candidate/manifest.json --provenance-label candidate-diagnostic --control /absolute/candidate/pilotdeck-control --gateway /absolute/candidate/pilotdeck-gateway --sidecar /absolute/candidate/pilotdeck-agent-loop-sidecar --host-mode control-serve --signal TERM --out /absolute/fresh/output

case.py is a parsed Python stimulus fragment inserted into the existing harness, not a separate runner. Added observations:
- raw HTTP1.1 health/close, HEAD no body, malformed Content-Length400 and HTTP1.0 plain/keepalive requests close-delimited without CL/TE/keepalive. The native HTTP1.0 status line follows existing registered 1.0-vs-Node1.1 difference, not a new normalization.
- wrong token: actual control status exit1/stdout empty/transport_error (its declared text client contract), independently actual WS close4003/auth_failed. watch's authentication_error classification is not incorrectly applied to status.
- actual control upload_create/part/complete, PNG SHA verification, official fixed TS RemoteGateway as WS client to Rust, real sidecar/model request receives exact base64 image_url. This tests Gateway consumption. Control stream deliberately accepts only a single text turn, so uploadedAttachments is not silently added to its whitelist.
- lease release checks actual second-level leaseId directories; empty uploadId container may remain, matching fixed TS UploadStore288-289/344.
- three independent public complete/cancel races each require exactly one successful transition and matching disk metadata/files. Native store's existing many-round concurrency unit tests remain complementary; three network races do not prove every interleaving.
- actual WS peer closes after delivered model delta without sending abort_turn, actual held provider connection closes, run is sampled boundedly until aborted/aborted_streaming. Provider EOF is not assumed to imply synchronous run-record persistence. Ordinary in-flight request disconnect semantics remain the existing native_ws tests' separate contract.
- original control stream success and explicit abort/provider close/sidecar identity cleanup; shutdown listener refuses connection and can be rebound.

Budgets: existing harness120s deadline; outer140s signal-to-cleanup protection; each child/network step bounded, raw HTTP1MiB response cap, each Node WS2MiB cap, mock provider2MiB body/24 request cap, maxOutputTokens256. Existing harness executes in private home/project with loopback mocks and PID/birth/executable observations; no user home/accounts/provider keys. Unknown processes are never killed. Source files and all failure evidence are preserved per run; final executed fixture bytes recovered/verified against every recorded SHA in fixture-source directories (source-recovery.json).

Observed r15 diagnostic results on mbp2: _tmp/20261110-native-network-r6 control-serve+TERM and r7 gateway+INT both pass/cleanup_verified/network_binary_snapshots_unchanged=true, each21 observation rows/8 provider requests. Receipt SHA551fb5b7bf93c12cfed1bd27faa431855bb1fce740dfe48f08ed830ce3748e56 binds9b9941b9 plus exact source snapshot, not a new formal acceptance commit. Gateway2505871bd39092125d4e5a44526794397e21be5ceb91e39291ae0c5855b67ece; sidecaraaebdc0bbc9f2846780dca1614319e1b1d4f728ad2f5966aac8f78e2683c6522. r1-r5 original failures remain: probe auth classification assumption, text-only CLI input, lease directory level and asynchronous terminal-persistence barrier; no product was changed to make them green. r2 repeated r1 because the attempted source edit failed, recorded honestly.

These are bounded real-network native diagnostics, not complete TS wire parity, Linux pidfd/strace retirement, hostile remote deployment validation, formal ICU78.2 acceptance, real provider or human signoff. Official baseline client hash/Node environment are recorded separately in the delivery evidence; future callers must provide the intended baseline and matching Node environment. Baseline path is not silently replaced by a Rust mock client.
